notes.note: Delta-review fix: when a refetched first page starts before the offset its param asked for (the server clamped a past-end read because the transcript was rewritten shorter), the tail query resets to the latest messages. Matches the SDK reference's 'a transcript rewritten shorter starts again from its latest messages'; no wording change.
